body:
Repository-merge milestone 9 (`project-pages`), research half.

- `site/build.py` writes `_site/<slug>/index.html` for all 393 projects from the new `site/project.html`: question, abstract, test count, README/paper/code/results links, AI-assistance note, theme, and the first image under the project's `experiments/`.
- Homepage cards link to the page. The build fails if any page cannot be built (missing README, unfilled placeholder).
- Limitation: only 7 projects ship an image today, so most pages have no figure yet. Noted in PROJECTS.md.
- `site/build.py` and `site/template.html` stay runnable unchanged in the oss-monorepo layout; `site/project.html` is new and is in `site/**`, so the mirror map carries it.

Verified: `python site/build.py` prints ok; rendered a page at desktop width.
